title: phyllostegia mannii
intro: Phyllostegia mannii, commonly known as Hawaiian Liatris or Island Blazing Star, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllostegia mannii include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
